Frequently Asked Questions

We just closed on a new build in Fountain Inn. What should we do first?

Register the HVAC equipment warranty in your name, then schedule a first-year inspection. That visit verifies the builder’s installation, documents refrigerant charge and airflow, and starts the service record most manufacturer warranties require. Small installation shortcuts caught early stay small.

How do I know if my sewer line is the problem rather than a single drain?

Watch the pattern. One slow fixture points to its own branch line, while multiple slow drains, gurgling, or backups at the lowest fixtures point to the main. A camera inspection confirms the location and condition before any repair is scoped.

Can you run a gas line for a standby generator?

Yes, and it is one licensed company for the whole project. The plumbing side installs and pressure-tests the gas supply, the electrical side sets the generator and transfer switch, and the sizing work happens before either begins.

Why does my new, tightly built house need a dehumidifier at all?

Tight construction keeps conditioned air in, but it also keeps moisture from cooking, showers, and occupancy in with it. On mild humid days the air conditioner barely runs, so little of that moisture gets removed. Dedicated dehumidification holds the range regardless of how much cooling the day requires.

What nearby areas does Carolina Heating Service cover?

Simpsonville, Mauldin, and Woodruff are all inside standard coverage along with the wider Upstate. The chat team confirms addresses in minutes.
